Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

Our mobile gaming portfolio includes AppMagic and Playliner, which help game developers and publishers understand the mobile games market and how top games run their LiveOps.



We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build LLM-powered prototypes for our gaming analytics products. You’ll turn product ideas into working prototypes on real data, find out quickly which ones are worth building, and then take the successful ones all the way to production together with our engineering teams.



What you’ll do

 - Build AI prototypes for game analytics, with a focus on multimodal data: screenshots, images and gameplay video. For example, recognizing LiveOps events from in-game screenshots or extracting what changed in a game update.

 - Choose and use the right models for each task (mainly Claude), balancing quality, speed and cost.

 - Build data pipelines with our Data Engineer to run models on large volumes of game data.

 - Measure quality so we know what works and what doesn’t.

 - Build retrieval and multi-step pipelines.

 - Turn the best prototypes into real product features together with our engineers.
   
   

Our tech stack

Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, OpenCV, PostgreSQL, S3, Kubernetes, TypeScript, React



What we’re looking for

 - Strong Python (TypeScript is a plus).

 - Experience with multimodal models: screenshots, images or video.

 - Hands-on experience building products on top of LLM APIs, not just chatbots.

 - Understanding of RAG and vector search, and when they’re not needed.

 - You measure results and can show how well your solution works.

 - You can work independently and explain your decisions clearly.

 - Ability to pass technical interview both in Russian & English.



What we’d be particularly excited about

 - Interest in or experience with mobile games, LiveOps or market analytics.

 - Hands on experience in building AI projects

 - Experience with LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks, and an opinion on when they’re worth using.

Two openings on a growing Data Operations team, building an enterprise data platform from the ground up.
 



  





 This is a fully remote role with a U.S.\-based professional services firm. Their technology, AI and data teams are expanding fast, and you’d be joining at exactly the right moment.
 



  





 The team is building its data platform on Microsoft Fabric. The Data Engineers own the core pipelines, and you’ll be the Python engineer who handles everything around them: building custom integrations with third\-party APIs, pulling data out of older systems that don’t connect easily, parsing messy and deeply nested data, and automating routine work alongside the Cloud and Database teams. No two weeks look the same, and you’ll be the person the team turns to when the standard tools can’t solve a problem.
 



  





 This role suits a software engineer who enjoys working with data, rather than a data engineer or data scientist. You’ll have strong production Python experience, ideally from backend, integrations or automation work, and you’ll be comfortable consuming RESTful APIs and dealing with authentication, pagination and rate limits. You’ll parse and transform JSON, XML and CSV using Pandas, write solid SQL, and have some exposure to PySpark or a platform like Fabric, Databricks or Synapse. You write clean, tested code, use Git and CI/CD as standard, and know that a “quick script” often ends up being something the business relies on.
 



  





 Just as important, you can connect your work to the bigger picture. You’ll be working with stakeholders across the firm, so you’ll need to understand what the business needs, explain technical trade\-offs in plain terms, and show how your work makes a difference.
 



  





 You’ll get full remote flexibility, hands\-on experience with a modern data platform, and a real part in the AI and data initiatives shaping how the firm operates.
